lines: Whose back line was that? Yours. It was yours.
I asked you for one thing. One.
You had one job and you gave it to someone else.
Don't look at me. Look at the scoreboard first.
That is on your clipboard, not mine.
Brilliant plan. Write it down so we never do it again.
Remind me to thank you in the press room.
Bold, that. Bold of you to try it on a Saturday.
No, keep talking. It has been going so well.
Lovely shape. Wrong sport, but lovely shape.
I have seen tighter marking at a bus stop.
My nan closes down quicker, and she is eighty.
You told me he was a defender. He is a rumour.
That was your formation. I have it in writing.
You said press high. High. Not into the car park.
Nice one. Do you want to tell the board, or shall I?
Every one of those substitutions was yours.
Next week you do the talking. See how you like it.
I trusted you with the corners. The corners.
Was that a plan, or did it just happen?
